comment: Single source of truth for the IRR -> IPD `iips-broker-import` alias consumption profile.
Read by `scripts/materialize-broker-import.mjs` (which materializes the pinned package's
published build output) and by `server/broker-import/brokerImportPackageConsumer.test.ts`
(the CAP-02 B-1R pin compatibility guard), so the guard and the build step cannot drift.
WHY THIS EXISTS: at alias pin 70b24f0 the IPD manifest declared no `files` field, so npm
packed the whole repository and IRR compiled the alias's raw TypeScript sources through
`tsconfig.broker-import.json`. From the DB-C1 package redesign onwards the IPD manifest
declares `files: ["dist/package"]`, so the installed alias publishes ONLY built `.js` plus
`.d.ts` artifacts. Advancing the alias to the PR #127 merge commit therefore requires IRR to
consume the published build output instead of raw sources. That is an IRR-owned build-input
change; it does not move identity resolution, quarantine or persistence out of IPD.
The alias is advanced to IPD PR #146 merge d5e20c15059267a3f824b015e37d652084de5a01, the current
authoritative IPD `main`. That revision is the first IPD `main` commit that carries the D05 AUTHENTICATED
universe (2,390 records, AUTH-D05-REPLACEMENT-AUTHENTICATED-UNIVERSE-ACT-2026-11-08-001), the Stage 4
identity-qualification implementation, AND the Stage 4D composition-root wiring plus the explicit local
single-user durable-write authorization (`src/persistence/localSingleUserAuthorization.ts`,
`src/ui/brokerImportApplicationPath.ts`, `src/ipc/brokerImportComposition.ts`).
It publishes the same `files: ["dist/package"]` / five-subpath export contract as the previous pin
(`./portfolio-ui`, `./pit`, `./d114-non-production`, `./operator-drop`, `./dhan-server`).
That five-subpath export map, the 18-module / 36-required-artifact profile and both runtime
entrypoints are UNCHANGED between 709fd13 and d5e20c15; the earlier `four-subpath` wording described
the pre-DHAN-P3 pin (`58fc8fb`) and is corrected here rather than repeated.
The published-output contract remains unchanged.
COMPATIBILITY: between the previous pin 58fc8fb7f033650f40d61078d70e951f21dd033f and
d5e20c15059267a3f824b015e37d652084de5a01 the ONLY change to the IRR-consumed broker-import
surface is `src/identity/governed_fixture_master.ts`. IPD retains `getGovernedBroadSecurityMaster()`
as a backwards-compatible alias that now resolves to the authenticated universe (2,390 records)
and moves the frozen Wave-1 corpus (2,250 records) behind
`getGovernedLegacyWave1SecurityMaster()`. No consumed module was removed or renamed, so the
existing IRR import path and the 18-module / 36-artifact profile are unchanged. IPD's
`broker_observation_resolver` execution-stage guard is re-pinned consistently by IPD itself
(recordCount 2390, the replacement act reference); IRR neither reimplements nor weakens it.
PR #146 adds runtime modules (IPC composition root, local single-user authorization, application
path), none of which are reachable from the `./portfolio-ui` closure. The published `dist/package`
tree at d5e20c15 is BYTE-IDENTICAL to 709fd13: the same 102 modules and the same 204 manifest
entries, and both revisions pack to the same npm tarball SHA-256. The lockfile `integrity` values
are therefore provably unchanged: advancing the pin changes no consumed byte while adopting the
revision IPD publishes as `main`.
